This Bail Application is filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.
2. Petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.299 of 2024 of Thalapuzha Police Station, Wayanad.

The above case is registered against the petitioner alleging offences punishable under Sections 498A and 302 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC'), 2023.
3.
Prosecution case is that the petitioner married the deceased on 01.11.1998.
The petitioner and the deceased were residing together as husband and wife and they have three children.
It is alleged that the accused mentally and physically harassed the deceased.

It is further alleged that in between 18.06.2024 at 11 p.m 2025:KER:9831 and 19.06.2024 at 1 a.m, while the victim was sleeping, the accused poured kerosene on her body and set her on fire and the victim suffered serious burn injuries, and later succumbed to the injuries.

The petitioner was arrested on 02.07.2024.
4.
This bail application was heard in detail on 31.01.2025.
This Court was not inclined to grant bail.

Therefore, this Court passed the following order on 31.01.2025:
"The Registry will get a report from the Addl. District and Sessions Court - II,
Kalpetta about the present stage of SC No.477/2024 and the time required to dispose of the case considering the pendency of the civil and criminal cases in that court."
5.

sentences.text: The Additional District Judge- I, Kalpetta, submitted a report, the same is extracted hereunder:
"In obedience to the direction issued as per the above cited reference the following report is respectfully submitted.

The final report in SC 477/2024 was filed before the JFCM-I,
Mananthavady on 03.10.2024 and resubmitted after curing the defects on 09.10.2024.
The case which was taken on file as CP 27/2024 was committed to the Hon'ble Sessions Court vide order dated 25.10.2024.
On receipt of the case records  1.11.2024 the case was numbered as SC 477/2024 and made over to this Court on 2.11.2024.
Since the accused is under judicial custody, production warrant was issued to produce the accused on 9.12.2024.
On 9.12.2024 the accused was produced and CMP 3754/24 was filed seeking bail.

The application was heard and disposed of vide Muneer.K vs State Of Kerala on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173030392/
2 order dated 16.12.2024 and adjourned to 09.01.2025.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On 09.01.2025 the accused was produced through video conferencing and remand was extended to 12.02.2025.
So now the case stands posted to 12.02.2025 for hearing on charge.
The prosecution has cited 53 witnesses in all.
The RFSL report and property are also seen received.
So after hearing both sides and framing charge, I may be able to schedule the case for trial during the month of April 2025.
I also submit that I may require at least 6 months time, thereafter to dispose of the case.
The above facts are respectfully submitted.
In the light of the above, I think this bail application can be disposed of.
Therefore, this bail application is disposed of directing the Additional District Judge-I, Kalpetta, to dispose S.C. No.477 of 2024 within six months from April 2025.

Sd/-
